current_dns_state.interpretation: www.csoai.org resolves to a Namecheap parking/forwarding address (162.255.119.208) while the apex csoai.org resolves to two Cloudflare anycast addresses. The apex is live and healthy behind Cloudflare and 308-redirects to councilof.ai. The www host is served by Namecheap's URL-forward and answers plain HTTP with a 302 to https://csoai.org, but its HTTPS endpoint never answers - the forward points at the apex hostname, which has no www.csoai.org in its certificate, and the CF edge answers with a handshake failure for that SNI.
current_dns_state.what_is_needed: An A record or CNAME is needed ONLY if www.csoai.org must serve content directly from Cloudflare. Two viable routes: (a) keep the Namecheap URL-forward but the HTTPS leg still needs a certificate that covers www.csoai.org - i.e. add www.csoai.org to the Cloudflare zone and point a CNAME 'www' -> 'csoai.org' (or -> 'councilof.ai') at Namecheap, which requires adding www to the zone so Cloudflare issues the SAN; or (b) if the intent is only 'www should reach the same place as csoai.org', the existing plain-HTTP 302 already satisfies it and only the HTTPS leg is broken.
current_dns_state.no_change_made_reason: The brief forbids touching DNS, and running setup-dns.sh would not even target this domain.

setup_dns_sh_analysis.what_it_does: For each of 26 hardcoded domains it calls the Namecheap XML API command namecheap.domains.dns.setHosts, overwriting the host set to exactly two records: HostName1=@ A 76.76.21.21 (Vercel) TTL 1800, and HostName2=www CNAME cname.vercel-dns.com TTL 1800. It never reads or preserves existing records.
setup_dns_sh_analysis.csoai_org_note: csoai.org is NOT in the DOMAINS array (the array contains councilof.ai and 25 other domains). Running the script would therefore NOT fix www.csoai.org at all.
setup_dns_sh_analysis.breakage_detail: The script would overwrite DNS for 26 unrelated domains, and 17 of them are on Cloudflare or Vercel nameservers where a Namecheap-side setHosts either fails or is irrelevant, while koikeeper.ai IS on Namecheap DNS and would be clobbered. It would also reset csoai.org's live apex/www configuration to a 2026-07-30-era Vercel target (the pre-migration backup /Users/nicholas/csoai-dns-backup-20260730-0502.txt shows apex A=76.76.21.21 and www CNAME=cname.vercel-dns.com), undoing the current working Cloudflare-fronted apex.
